column1: # eMudhra's own list of the subordinate CA certificates 0.1.17 adds, as data: a witness for
# emudhra-2026-11-g2-cas.pem and for lib/incidents/emudhra-2026-10.json's reviewKeys that is not either of them.
# Source: Mozilla bug 2083449, comment 82 (eMudhra's full incident report, posted 2026-11-10T18:35:42Z), its Appendix
# C (the eight RSA-4096 G2B/G2C CAs, revoked 7 Nov 2026 with reason cessationOfOperation) and the two code-signing
# rows of Appendices A and B (EM OV CS CA - G3B and G3C, revoked 18 Oct 2026, and their AAA Certificate Services
# cross-certificates, revoked 19 Oct 2026). Read on 11 Nov 2026 through Bugzilla's REST API
# (bugzilla.mozilla.org/rest/bug/2083449/comment), not through a summariser. Nothing is derived from this file:
# the eight RSA fingerprints are also derived from certificate bytes (the PEM beside it); the four code-signing
# fingerprints are the only copy here, because their certificates were not saved.
# Columns: appendix, SHA-256 (as eMudhra prints it), subject CN, issuer CN, serial (as eMudhra prints it).
